verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is a brief mention that the API root documents "eight regional API domains," implying Zoho Books operates data centers in multiple regions — a proxy for data residency options — but there is no explicit documentation of a user-facing region/residency selection at signup or account level, nor any privacy-page confirmation of data locality guarantees. missing for 10: explicit account creation region-selection documentation, data residency/privacy policy statement, independent confirmation of regional data storage enforcement.
